title: Fix-I api: 117-F008/F004/F005/F007 (REQ-0126)

design.summary: api.py only: 119.1 cut merge = options union + figures + continued_pages; 119.2 range closes when num <= last; 119.3 open a range only when its span covers the carrier; 119.4 N + offset note only for consecutive ids

implementation.summary: api.py: 119.1 cut merge union (options, figures, continued_pages); 119.2 restart closes a range only when it never resumes, outside carrier starts last at lo-1; 119.3 a mention not covering its number is ignored only for a member of the open range; 119.4 offset note only for consecutive ids. 7 new tests (5 bite, 2 guards)

next: tester: --fast, bite, and regression tests for the two real patterns (false carrier outside span, stray low id in a group)
